metadata.title: That 3 kill spree where Valorant was like ‘Wait, you’re serious? No way!’
metadata.description:
Wait, did I just steal that?
My aim was on break but the enemy clearly wasn’t paying attention.
Click if your best moments come from pure accident chaos.
Valorant logic is wild today.

Tap if your kills make zero sense but still feel amazing!
